title.zh: 【Circle 与 ACI Worldwide 合作将 USDC 结算引入拉美现有支付基础设施】
title.en: 【Circle 与 ACI Worldwide 合作将 USDC 结算引入拉美现有支付基础设施】

current_state.zh: Circle is partnering with ACI Worldwide to demonstrate how banks can embed USDC settlement into existing payment operations, starting with Colombia's Bre-B real-time payment network to explore a multi-rail settlement model alongside traditional channels.
current_state.en: Circle is partnering with ACI Worldwide to demonstrate how banks can embed USDC settlement into existing payment operations, starting with Colombia's Bre-B real-time payment network to explore a multi-rail settlement model alongside traditional channels.
